description: classify() promises a typed answer, so when its own answer comes back malformed (a choice without probabilities) the call raises ServerError (status 200, reason from the x-decisionnode-error header) instead of returning an UnknownAnswer. decide() with the same answer returns an UnknownAnswer; see responses/malformed-known-answers.
